params.QUERY: SELECT TOP 1000 g.source_id,g.ref_epoch,g.ra,g.dec,g.pmra,g.pmdec,g.phot_g_mean_mag,g.phot_variable_flag,g.ruwe,c.best_class_name,c.best_class_score,c.classifier_name,s.num_selected_g_fov,s.trimmed_range_mag_g_fov,s.in_vari_eclipsing_binary,s.in_vari_rotation_modulation,s.in_vari_ms_oscillator FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.vari_classifier_result AS c ON g.source_id=c.source_id LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.vari_summary AS s ON g.source_id=s.source_id WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',g.ra,g.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',113.837837026058,-76.6806977752492,0.00611111112))
